policy: Fields remain optional for inheritance and partial overrides; no defaults or discriminator values are inserted.

A literal type selects its named element definition using the Wiki Allowed Properties table. Known properties outside that type are rejected unless a property-specific bundled compatibility record permits them.
When type is absent or an unresolved expression, validate all known property types without inferring a base type from inheritance. Unknown properties remain open.
Animation definitions are separate from control element types. anim_type presence selects animation properties; anim_type-specific from/to semantics are not evaluated.
Explicit enum values and vector lengths are checked. References, expression evaluation, target existence and game behavior are outside static validation.
type and anim_type cannot be specified together; unresolved type expressions still retain all known property type checks.

ElementProperties preserves the full field contract for partial overrides; concrete type definitions reuse the documented property groups. Its fields are materialized once to avoid repeatedly expanding all groups for every recursive control.
